c97ee656e5d00a04.description: Job Purpose: Embedded within the City Operations Finance & Control team, the Procurement Manager will support the Directors in delivering procurement across City Assets. As the City asset portfolio expands and procurement activity increases, the role will provide the additional capacity and coordination required to maintain timely delivery, robust governance and effective stakeholder support. The role will drive reporting and process discipline, coordinate activity across functions, support the preparation of approval papers, and help progress new and evolving contracts through the end-to-end procurement lifecycle. Role Responsibilities: · Support the Senior Manager and Directors in planning and delivering the City Operations procurement pipeline, ensuring priorities, dependencies and lead times are visible. · Coordinate end-to-end procurement activities, including requirements development, RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, bid evaluations, supplier selection, negotiation, award and contract execution. · Work with City asset and operational teams to develop clear scopes, commercial requirements and procurement documentation for new and evolving contracts. · Support the drafting and quality assurance of approval papers, tender documentation, evaluation materials and governance submissions. · Drive procurement reporting, dashboards and KPIs covering pipeline status, sourcing progress, approvals, risks, savings and key decisions required. · Maintain effective processes, trackers and workflows to improve procurement visibility, consistency and timely delivery. · Coordinate with central Procurement, Finance, Legal, Operations, IT and other stakeholders to progress reviews, approvals and contracting activities. · Support commercial negotiations and supplier engagement to secure competitive pricing, appropriate terms and value for money. · Ensure procurement activity complies with policy, delegated authority, governance, regulatory and audit-trail requirements. · Provide responsive day-to-day procurement support to City Operations stakeholders and escalate material risks or delays appropriately. Experience: · Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in Procurement, Supply Chain or Commercial roles, preferably within a complex operating environment. · Practical experience supporting the full sourcing lifecycle and multiple concurrent procurement activities. · Experience preparing or contributing to procurement strategies, approval papers, tender documents, evaluations and contract award recommendations. · Strong reporting and analytical capability, with experience maintaining procurement pipelines, dashboards, KPIs and management information. · Sound commercial acumen, including pricing analysis, negotiation support, total cost considerations and identification of commercial risk. · Experience working across operational service categories such as public realm, facilities management, maintenance, utilities, security, transport, events or similar areas is advantageous. · Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to coordinate effectively across Operations, Procurement, Finance, Legal and other support functions. · Organized and delivery-focused, with the ability to manage competing priorities, follow through on actions and work effectively in a growing, high-pressure environment. · Clear written and verbal communication, with strong attention to detail and confidence preparing material for senior review. · Working knowledge of procurement governance, delegated authority, tender controls, supplier risk and contract management principles. · Experience with Horizon SAP system Qualifications · Bachelor's degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Business Administration, Commercial Management or a related field. · Professional qualification such as CIPS/MCIPS or CPSM is advantageous. · Experience in Saudi Arabia, the GCC, major development or large-scale operational environments is advantageous.

c927665ef9bc76d3.description: About United Motors Group United Motors Group is seeking a Technician to join their team in Dammam. This full-time role involves performing vehicle inspection, maintenance, diagnosis, and repair activities to ensure high-quality service in accordance with manufacturer and dealership standards. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to conduct comprehensive vehicle servicing, ensuring all tasks are performed safely, efficiently, and to the required quality standards. The Technician will be responsible for maintaining vehicle integrity and functionality through precise diagnostic and repair work. Key Responsibilities Perform routine vehicle maintenance, servicing, and mechanical repairs. Inspect vehicles to identify mechanical faults and maintenance requirements. Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical issues using appropriate tools and diagnostic equipment. Carry out repairs and replacement of defective mechanical components. Perform oil changes, brake servicing, suspension repairs, cooling system maintenance, and other general mechanical work. Follow manufacturer repair procedures, technical specifications, and dealership standards. Use workshop tools, equipment, and diagnostic systems safely and correctly. Conduct vehicle inspections before and after repairs to ensure proper completion. Maintain accurate records of repairs, parts used, and work performed. Communicate identified vehicle issues and additional repair requirements to the Service Advisor or Workshop Supervisor. Ensure all work is completed within assigned time and productivity standards. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area. Comply with company policies, safety procedures, and environmental requirements. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or technical certificate in Automotive Technology, Automotive Mechanics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. 1–2 years of hands-on experience as an Auto Mechanic, preferably within an automotive dealership or authorized service center. Required Skills Basic knowledge of vehicle mechanical systems and automotive diagnostics. Application Process Candidates meeting the above qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time Technician position in Dammam.

c92d401363a3b81e.description: About the Role proven is seeking a Lead IoT and System Integration Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves designing, deploying, and managing the end-to-end IoT sensor hardware, telemetry gateways, and system architecture for a centralized monitoring platform. The position focuses on ensuring continuous, real-time data capture across vital hospital utilities and establishing secure data pipelines to the unified central Ministry of Health (MOH) platform. Key Responsibilities Design and deploy sensor instrumentation for continuous fill level, consumption rate, and inventory monitoring across fuel tanks, water storage, and medical oxygen/air tanks. Implement telemetry controllers for ICU and Operating Room emergency medical gas units to capture real-time pressure drops, flow rates, and stock levels. Integrate indoor environmental sensors to monitor HVAC performance and Room Air Quality compliance in accordance with healthcare facility standards. Interface IoT hardware with critical ICU power infrastructure, including emergency generators, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), battery chargers, and Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) units. Connect monitoring modules to track the operational readiness of automatic fire suppression systems (sprinklers, clean agent systems) and fire pumps. Configure real-time operational occupancy sensors within critical care units. Establish edge-to-cloud data pipelines to transmit live hospital telemetry to the central MOH platform for ministry-level data unification. Configure automated early-warning triggers and instant alerts for readiness failures or system pressure drops to initiate immediate backup procedures. Maintain end-to-end data security, encryption, and communication reliability between hospital hardware and the central platform. Conduct field calibration, system testing, and verification of sensor signal accuracy across all hospital installations. Collaborate with data teams to leverage sensor streams for predictive maintenance algorithms, aiming to reduce critical failures and improve operational spending efficiency. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required. Experience with hospital infrastructure, smart facility telemetry, or medical system monitoring is highly preferred. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and operates on a full-time basis, contributing to critical healthcare infrastructure monitoring.

c9b680ff1b2c4fff.description: About the Role of Legal Specialist Al Salama Hospital is seeking a Legal Specialist to join its Legal team in Makkah. This full-time role involves providing expert legal counsel on complex matters to safeguard the hospital’s interests. The specialist will manage litigation, review high-value contracts, handle employment disputes, and ensure compliance with Saudi Arabian laws and regulations. The position reports directly to the Director of Legal Affairs. Key Responsibilities Draft, review, and negotiate high-stakes contracts. Provide expert legal counsel on complex legal matters. Prepare written legal opinions and memoranda for management and departments. Manage and oversee all aspects of litigation and pre-litigation claims. Supervise and manage the performance of external legal counsel. Handle medical malpractice and patient complaint cases before the Health Violations Committees. Address employment disputes before labor courts and the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development. Prepare powers of attorney, pleadings, and responses, and follow up cases through electronic systems such as Najiz. Identify legal risks in hospital operations and contracts and recommend preventive actions. Monitor new and amended laws and regulations affecting the hospital and advise on required actions. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s Degree in Law (** is required. A Master’s Degree in Law (** or certification in corporate law is considered an advantage. Must be a licensed legal practitioner from the Ministry of Justice. A minimum of 3 years of progressive legal experience is required, with a focus on corporate, litigation, or healthcare law. Experience in Saudi Arabia is preferred. Experience within healthcare institutions is preferred. Work Location This full-time position is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Candidates from Jeddah are also encouraged to apply.

c9d2f96d2ab1f0f4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ركن الجناء للمقاولات عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مراجعة وتدقيق وإدخال البيانات والمعلومات بدقة في أنظمة الحاسب الآلي، مع ضمان الحفاظ على سرية البيانات. الغرض من الوظيفة يتولى مدخل البيانات مسؤولية معالجة البيانات بكفاءة وفعالية، بدءًا من مراجعة الاستمارات وتدقيقها وحتى تخزين المعلومات وعمل النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان دقة وسلامة البيانات المخزنة والالتزام بالمعايير المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة الاستمارات المتعلقة بالبيانات وترميزها والتأكد من اكتمالها. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات في الحاسب الآلي وفقًا للبرامج والنظم الإحصائية المعتمدة. مراجعة رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة، وتصويب الأخطاء فيها لضمان الدقة. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بطريقة منظمة وآمنة. عمل النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة بشكل دوري. التقيد الصارم بالتعليمات والإجراءات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال إدخال البيانات أو مجال مشابه. القدرة على مراجعة وتدقيق البيانات بدقة عالية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج إدخال البيانات وأنظمة الحاسب الآلي. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. تتطلب الالتزام بساعات العمل المحددة والتعاون مع فريق العمل لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة. تقديم الطلبات نرحب بالمرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقدم لهذه الوظيفة. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية.

c9dbb80d6fc4f5db.description: About the Role FNRCO is seeking an experienced Project Manager for Retail Banking to lead and oversee strategic e-channel banking initiatives. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves managing projects from requirements gathering and solution design through implementation, governance, and continuous improvement. Role Overview The Project Manager will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to ensure that e-channel banking solutions meet business requirements, regulatory expectations, customer needs, and organizational objectives. The successful candidate will provide strategic direction, lead project teams, manage multiple initiatives, and ensure the successful delivery of e-channel banking projects. Key Responsibilities Identify and document business needs and user requirements for e-channel banking products and services. Analyze current e-channel systems and processes to identify areas for improvement and optimization. Engage with stakeholders to understand their needs, gather feedback, and ensure alignment with business objectives. Develop detailed functional specifications and design solutions to address business requirements. Oversee the implementation of e-channel solutions, including project planning, execution, and monitoring. Ensure thorough testing of e-channel systems to validate functionality, performance, and security. Create and maintain documentation related to system requirements, processes, and project progress. Ensure e-channel solutions comply with regulatory requirements and manage risks associated with new implementations. Provide training and support to end-users to facilitate smooth adoption and use of e-channel solutions. Monitor performance of e-channel solutions and recommend enhancements to improve user experience and operational efficiency. Develop and execute high-level project strategies for e-channel banking initiatives, aligning with organizational goals. Lead and mentor project managers and teams, ensuring effective project execution and fostering professional growth. Manage relationships with senior stakeholders, ensuring their needs are addressed and expectations are met. Oversee multiple e-channel projects, ensuring they are aligned with strategic objectives and delivering value. Manage and approve large-scale project budgets, ensuring financial control and cost efficiency. Develop and implement risk management strategies to address potential issues and minimize impact on project outcomes. Establish and enforce project governance frameworks, ensuring adherence to organizational standards and regulatory requirements. Track project performance metrics, analyzing progress and implementing corrective actions as needed. Lead change management initiatives to ensure smooth transitions and user adoption of new e-channel systems. Provide executive-level reports and presentations on project status, risks, and achievements to senior management and stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience as an E-Channel Banking Project Manager. 5-10 years of relevant experience in project management within retail banking, specifically with e-channel initiatives. Strong understanding of e-channel banking products, services, and regulatory requirements. Demonstrated ability to lead project teams and manage multiple initiatives concurrently. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment focused on strategic e-channel banking initiatives.

c962f3baf9f4d631.description: About the Internship NOV, Inc. is offering an Accountant (COOP / Intern) position in Dammam, Eastern Province. This internship program is designed for fresh graduates to gain practical experience within an accounting department, providing a foundational understanding of financial operations and record-keeping. Role Overview The Accountant intern will support the accounting department by performing essential tasks related to financial data management, reconciliations, and month-end closing processes. This role is an excellent opportunity for individuals with 0-1 years of experience to apply their academic knowledge in a professional setting and develop key accounting skills. Key Responsibilities Perform data entry for financial transactions, vendor bills, and invoices into the ERP system. Assist with bank reconciliations, petty cash checks, and matching account balances to identify discrepancies. Support month-end closing activities by preparing basic journal entries, compiling supporting documentation, and organizing work papers. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

c90131b5d6027bfa.description: About the Role Amazon Saudi Arabia is seeking an Operations Executive to join its newly formed Ultra Fast Grocery (UFG) operations team. This full-time role involves contributing to the design and launch of new business models across AMET, focusing on redefining fast delivery services and managing 3P Store Operations. The position is available in Al-Ahsa and Dammam and requires 0-1 year of experience. Role Context and Mission The Operations Executive will play a role in building and running new services for Amazon customers. This includes ensuring that Amazon policies, such as attendance tracking, are implemented and administered consistently. The mission is to enable customers to find, discover, and buy anything online, with a commitment to delivering customer requests effectively. Key Responsibilities Managing daily end-to-end UTR operations for one large site or a combination of smaller sites, including supervising store operations. Meeting customer-facing metrics while maintaining operational and quality targets. Upholding the safety and morale of the team. Driving performance management for team members. Preparing and implementing training and development plans for pickers. Collaborating with merchant stakeholders to continuously improve operational processes and achieve sustained performance improvement. Conducting 4M / 5S and Safety GEMBA audits for stores on a daily basis. Acting as a stand-in for the Area Manager when required. c90590efcd42e924.description: About the Role Ninja, a supply chain company, is seeking a Putaway Team Leader to manage daily putaway operations at its Central Warehouse. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the accurate, safe, and timely movement of received inventory into designated storage locations, while upholding operational efficiency, inventory accuracy, and safety standards. Role Overview The Putaway Team Leader oversees the entire putaway process, from staging areas to final storage. This involves coordinating resources, monitoring performance, and ensuring compliance with all warehouse protocols. The position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience in warehouse operations or a similar field. Key Responsibilities Supervise daily putaway activities to ensure timely movement of inventory from staging areas to storage locations. Allocate tasks and coordinate manpower and material-handling equipment effectively. Monitor putaway productivity, track pending tasks, manage backlog, and assess overall operational performance. Ensure accurate pallet identification, correct storage locations, and precise WMS (Warehouse Management System) transactions. Coordinate with Receiving, Stock Control, and other warehouse teams to resolve operational discrepancies promptly. Enforce warehouse safety, quality, storage, and inventory-handling standards consistently. Identify and propose opportunities for process improvement and enhanced operational efficiency within the putaway function. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be disclosed to qualified candidates.

c90695b1d8bd9754.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة وبيل المتحدة للتشغيل والصيانة عن مشرف مزرعة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة تخطيط وتنفيذ العمليات التشغيلية الزراعية في مزارع المحاصيل المختلطة ومزارع الحيوانات، مع التركيز على استنبات المحاصيل وزراعتها وحصادها، بالإضافة إلى تربية الحيوانات ومتابعة نموها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية زراعة المحاصيل والإشراف على جميع مراحل الإنتاج، بما في ذلك تحضير الحقول، واستنبات النباتات ومتابعة نموها، وحصادها أو قطفها. متابعة نمو الحيوانات والإشراف على جميع مراحل الإنتاج، وتربية الحيوانات ومتابعة نموها، وأداء المهام ذات الصلة مثل الحلب أو الجز. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة والصحة العامة المعتمدة. تشغيل المركبات والآليات والمعدات الزراعية الأخرى، والقيام بأعمال التنظيف والصيانة الأساسية لها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الإشراف الزراعي أو إدارة المزارع. فهم جيد لعمليات زراعة المحاصيل ورعاية الحيوانات. القدرة على تشغيل وصيانة المعدات والآليات الزراعية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تخطيط وتنظيم العمليات الزراعية. القدرة على متابعة وتنفيذ إجراءات الصحة والسلامة. مهارات التواصل الفعال والعمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل لهذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل مشرف المزرعة ضمن بيئة تتطلب التواجد الميداني والإشراف المباشر على العمليات الزراعية اليومية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة وبيل المتحدة للتشغيل والصيانة.

c92e00bbc591f009.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Horticulturalist - Indoor Gardens to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves supporting the care, maintenance, propagation, and presentation of indoor plant collections and horticultural displays. The role focuses on ensuring high standards of plant health, horticultural quality, sustainability, and visitor experience within indoor garden environments. Role Context and Responsibilities The Indoor Gardens team is responsible for maintaining diverse plant collections. This role provides practical and technical support across various horticultural operations, working closely with the Horticulturalist, Botanic Garden Curator, and the wider horticulture team. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Maintain indoor plant collections, displays, and controlled growing environments, including greenhouses. Perform routine plant care tasks such as watering, pruning, repotting, fertilization, plant replacement, and propagation. Monitor plant health to identify pests, diseases, nutrient deficiencies, and environmental stress. Support and implement Integrated Pest Management (IPM) strategies and appropriate plant-health treatments. Monitor environmental factors including temperature, humidity, light, ventilation, irrigation, growing media, and plant nutrition. Maintain accurate plant inventories, labels, databases, and horticultural records. Support plant propagation using various methods such as seeds, cuttings, and division. Ensure high horticultural, aesthetic, cleanliness, and visitor-experience standards. Support greenhouse operations, indoor display maintenance, and plant collection management. Collaborate with horticulture teams, botanists, contractors, and other multidisciplinary teams. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Horticulture, Botany, Plant Sciences, or a related discipline. Relevant experience in indoor horticulture, indoor garden management, greenhouse, conservatory, or controlled growing environments. Practical experience in plant care, propagation, pruning, repotting, irrigation, fertilization, and general plant maintenance. Experience in identifying plant pests, diseases, nutrient deficiencies, and environmental stress. Knowledge and practical experience with Integrated Pest Management (IPM). Experience monitoring temperature, humidity, light, irrigation, ventilation, and growing conditions. Experience maintaining plant collections, horticultural displays, plant records, and inventories. Required Skills Strong attention to detail. Practical problem-solving abilities. Effective communication skills. Teamwork skills. Preferred Experience Experience in a botanic garden, greenhouse, conservatory, nursery, public garden, or similar horticultural facility is preferred. Work Environment This role is based in Saudi Arabia and involves working within indoor garden settings, greenhouses, and controlled growing environments. The successful candidate will be part of a collaborative team dedicated to horticultural excellence.

This full-time role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Implement purchasing procedures to maintain supply and demand security for department operations and ensure optimal value. Organize high-quality catering services. Maintain regular inventory of all incoming goods and submit inventory reports. Ensure all purchase requests are completed correctly, including proper documentation of materials and expenses. c9d4f4d0822834dc.description: About AlBorg Diagnostics AlBorg Diagnostics is seeking a Support Services Coordinator to join its team. This role ensures that facilities, maintenance, cleaning, security, transportation, office supplies, and other related services are provided on time and according to company standards. Coordinate maintenance, cleaning, security, transportation, hospitality, office supplies, and other support services. Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities with internal teams and external service providers. Conduct regular site inspections and report any maintenance, safety, cleanliness, or facility-related issues. Coordinate with suppliers and service providers and follow up on agreed services, schedules, and service quality. Confirm that requested services have been completed before forwarding related invoices and documents for approval. Maintain accurate records of service requests, maintenance activities, supplier documents, invoices, and service reports. Support office setup, employee seating arrangements, office moves, and the preparation of work areas when required. c9655f1fcb1112fa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث فرع شركة تشاينا ناشيونال كيميكال انجنيرنج ثيرد كونستركشن كمباني عن كاتب علاقات حكومية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة المعاملات الإدارية والحكومية المتعلقة بالمشروع والعاملين، وضمان إنجاز الإجراءات بكفاءة وفي الوقت المحدد. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بالوثائق والمتطلبات اللازمة لإصدار وتجديد بطاقات تعريف العاملين وتصاريح الدخول إلى مواقع المشاريع. التنسيق مع إدارة المشروع والعميل والجهات المختصة لاستكمال الإجراءات والمعاملات المطلوبة بسرعة وفعالية وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. إعداد وتحديث واستكمال النماذج والمستندات المتعلقة بالعاملين وتصاريح الدخول إلى مواقع العمل. متابعة صلاحية البطاقات والتصاريح واتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة لتجديدها في المواعيد المحددة. التنسيق والتواصل مع الجهات الحكومية والمؤسسات والهيئات الأخرى ذات العلاقة بالمشروع. تقديم الوثائق والمستندات والمعلومات المطلوبة، ومتابعة المعاملات والإجراءات اللازمة وفقاً للأنظمة والتعليمات المعتمدة. حفظ الوثائق والسجلات وتنظيمها وتحديثها. متابعة معاملات العاملين بالتنسيق مع الأقسام المعنية وممثلي العميل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على توفير المستندات والمعلومات المطلوبة لضمان إنجاز المعاملات والإجراءات بكفاءة. المهارات المطلوبة إتقان اللغتين العربية والإنجليزية بطلاقة في التواصل الشفهي والمراسلات الرسمية. مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة الوثائق والسجلات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتنسيق مع الأطراف الداخلية والخارجية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية، ويكون العمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى دعم العمليات الإدارية والحكومية للمشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

c98d64eb65ea529d.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على جميع جوانب عمليات الصيانة، بما في ذلك تخطيط العمل، وتوزيع المهام، وتقييم الأداء، وتطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل التفصيلية لعمليات الصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة بشكل دوري وتقييم إنجازاتهم. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو دور إشرافي ذي صلة. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج عمل فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في توزيع المهام وإدارة فريق العمل. القدرة على تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. معرفة قوية ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية وإجراءات تنفيذها. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل مشرف الصيانة ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في الحفاظ على كفاءة وجودة العمليات التشغيلية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

c9992aa82aa6b8ff.description: About Carrier Carrier is a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, dedicated to developing innovations that enhance comfort, safety, and sustainability in buildings and communities. The Senior Project Engineer ensures projects are delivered according to technical requirements, schedules, budgets, quality standards, and customer expectations. Key Responsibilities Conduct site surveys for HVAC and mechanical replacement projects, verifying existing conditions, identifying technical requirements, and defining the scope of work. Prepare comprehensive Requests for Quotation (RFQs), including scope of work, Bill of Quantities (BOQs), technical requirements, drawings, and relevant site information. c9000674c5918838.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في القصيم. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة قوية ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل وصيانة التجهيزات والمعدات الميكانيكية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة القصيم بالمملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة استشارية هندسية رائدة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الكشف عنه في هذه المرحلة. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة رائدة في مجال الاستشارات الهندسية.

c92d1563b9807024.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تصميم السكن عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة المتعلقة بمراقبة دوام الموظفين، والإشراف على تطبيق سياسات الإجازات، وتحديث بيانات الموظفين، والتعامل مع استفساراتهم وشكواهم بمهنية عالية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الموارد البشرية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم على اختلاف أنواعها، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق جميع البيانات مثل الترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة والمتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم عميق لإجراءات وأنظمة الموارد البشرية، بما في ذلك إدارة الدوام والإجازات. القدرة على التعامل مع شكاوى واستفسارات الموظفين بمهنية وفعالية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التواصل الشفهي والكتابي. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تحديث البيانات وحفظها. القدرة على حل المشكلات وتقديم التوصيات المناسبة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في الرياض، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمليات الموارد البشرية في شركة تصميم السكن. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

c9a0db3cfaeae857.description: About the Role: Medical Manager Novartis Saudi Arabia is seeking a Medical Manager to join their team in Riyadh. c92f0be683d24815.description: Namaa Partners is hiring a Junior Operations Analyst to support the operational side of the firm's mandates: the reporting, tracking and working documents that let a principal walk into a board or committee meeting with numbers that hold up. The hire carries the recurring cadence from the start, keeping engagement reporting accurate and current across active mandates, and building a clear operating picture of how the firm runs its work. This is an entry-level role with real accountability for the material other people rely on. You will work from Riyadh on a hybrid basis, alongside principals and analysts. About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a strategy advisory firm working mostly with organizations in Saudi Arabia and with companies that have significant interests there. The work covers corporate strategy, growth and market entry, operating model and efficiency, organization and talent, digital strategy, performance improvement, and governance and risk. Clients include family groups and their holding companies, listed corporations, private equity portfolio companies, banks and insurers, government entities, and industrial operators. Principals scope the mandates and then deliver them, so the analysis that enters a decision is the analysis of the people who signed it. What You Will Do Maintain the active mandate tracker: engagement status, key dates, named owners and the next decision point, updated weekly and circulated before Monday. Build and refresh the reporting packs that principals take into board and committee meetings, checking that every figure traces back to its source before it leaves the office. Sit in on internal scoping and staffing conversations, take the notes, and turn them into a short written record with owners and dates attached. Pull together the firm's operating data on mandate pipeline, utilization and engagement economics, and flag where the numbers have moved. Prepare the first draft of client working documents such as issue logs, action registers and meeting minutes, then revise them with the principal who owns the mandate. Keep templates and reference material for recurring deliverables consistent, so a new engagement does not start from a blank page. What We Need From You A bachelor's degree, or an equivalent record of structured analytical work you can describe plainly. Comfort with spreadsheets and slide decks: you can build a clean model of a small dataset and format a page without being asked to fix it twice. Writing that another person can read once and act on. Short sentences, clear headings, no filler. Care with numbers. You check a total against its parts before you send it, not after someone asks. Arabic and English, spoken and written, at a level that lets you follow a client conversation and write up what was decided. Willingness to ask what a term means when a client uses it and you are not certain, rather than guessing at it in a document. How Decisions Get Made The principal who scopes a mandate staffs it and stays with it through delivery. They set what the engagement needs week to week and sign off on anything that goes to a client. As the analyst on a mandate, you report to that principal and to the engagement lead they name, and your tracking documents are part of how they judge where a piece of work actually stands. If something is slipping, the expectation is that you raise it early in plain terms rather than at the deadline. Your read on the numbers is one of the inputs before a decision is taken. What The Role Offers This is a permanent, full-time position based in Riyadh, working on a hybrid arrangement. You will see how mandates are scoped and staffed from the inside, sit close to the working sessions where a view gets formed, and learn what a defensible number looks like when a board is asking about it. The exposure spans family groups, listed corporations, financial institutions and government entities, across strategy, operating model and performance work. It is a role for someone who wants to learn the craft by doing the operational part of it properly. People do well here when they write, when they are comfortable working through ambiguity in a client's own vocabulary, and when they are content to be accountable for a number. You will often be given a question and a rough deadline rather than a set of steps. What matters is that the tracker is current, the pack is right, and the principal who opens it knows what it says before the meeting starts. If that way of working suits you, the first year will be spent learning more about how decisions get made than most junior roles allow.

c9b83aaf82033af5.description: Sanabil Studio is a venture builder that blends industry expertise, technology, and startup know-how to turn bold ideas into real businesses. We take concepts from zero to launch, and when a venture proves its potential, we back it with seed funding and hands-on support to help it scale. We believe the Saudi auto-parts trade is held back by a liquidity gap: garages struggle to get the right parts fast and on fair terms, while suppliers won't carry the payment risk. Whoever closes that gap wins the market. We are a B2B marketplace that supplies large garages in Riyadh with spare parts from vetted wholesalers, owning the ordering, delivery and, critically, the payments. We give garages workable terms and pay suppliers, carrying the collection risk no one else will. We are the founding team building this venture from concept to a licensed, scaling business, starting with a Riyadh pilot We are looking for a Co-Founder - Technology & Product to own the product and the data platform and, if this is the venture's chosen moat, its long-term defensibility. You will build the professional ordering platform and the data layer (orders, payments, inventory, demand) that powers pricing, credit decisions, and, in time, an ERP-style position inside the workshop. You will build tech from zero and lead engineering and product alongside the venture's PM. THE ROLE: What you'll own here. Own the product and technology end-to-end: a professional web ordering platform and the data layer behind it. Build the most critical features first: ship fast for the pilot, then harden and scale. Own the data and underwriting infrastructure: the data that powers pricing, credit decisions and reporting (the moat). Own integrations: supplier inventory/pricing, payments/collections, and (later) insurer and ERP integrations. Build and lead the engineering and product team, and own architecture, security, and data governance (PDPL). THE PROFILE: You're probably a fit if… You have 8+ years building B2B, marketplace, or fintech products, as a technical co-founder or senior engineering leader. You have personally built and launched a marketplace, B2B commerce, or fintech platform from 0 to 1 (a verifiable track record). You deeply understand marketplace and payments/credit data flows and can build the data/underwriting layer. You have led an engineering team and owned architecture decisions. You communicate clearly with the CEO, the finance/credit lead, and the PM. You are fluent in English (Arabic a plus) and based in Riyadh or willing to relocate. Bonus: KSA/GCC market experience; ZATCA e-invoicing; embedded-finance / BNPL integrations; ERP or workshop-management-system experience. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE : Within the first 12 months, you'll... Have a live platform used for 100% of orders, with all data captured in a single source of truth. Have a data layer powering pricing and credit decisions, not just transactions. Have shipped the core supplier and payment integrations reliably. Have a scalable, secure, PDPL-compliant architecture and a hired product and engineering team. Be recognised as someone who ships fast without breaking trust across the team. WHAT THE VENTURE PROVIDES: Validated thesis, financial model and market sizing: a de-risked concept with the commercial playbook. Pre-seed capital to build and prove the model, with follow-on support when it works. Operational backbone: legal, finance, hiring, and governance. Hands-on studio support: a venture team working alongside you from day one.
